outputs.explanation: Panel A includes bar graphs (nuclear, cytosolic, and mitochondrial fraction quantifications) showing mean ± SD with error bars, but no individual data points (dots) are overlaid on the bars, even though N=4 is stated.
Panel B is an immunoelectron micrograph, not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel C is a western blot image without an accompanying quantification plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel D is a western blot (proteinase K protection assay) without an accompanying quantification plot, so the check does not apply.
